title: Pipeline human decision attribution v1
description: The restricted machine-local attribution record (GMW/HGO design D-1, increment 2). Never admitted portably -- the governance schema and store additionally require storageProfile 'restricted-machine-local' for this payload. Carries exactly the two values the portable human-governance-decision payload structurally excludes: the free-text rationale and the trust anchor's {keyReference, publicKeySha256} pair. No decisionId, link, candidate, artifact, ruleDigest, policyDigest or validity field exists here, and timeBucketEpochMs is bucketed rather than exact, because §5.2 R-2 of the design forbids any record-level correlator crossing between this zone and the portable one.
